final_message:
I fixed the bug. `is_redeemable` in `billing/discounts.py` compared `times_redeemed > max_redemptions`, so a coupon with `max_redemptions=1` that had already been used once still counted as redeemable. I changed `>` to `>=`.

I didn't add your reproduction test to the suite. The suite itself passes (24 tests). I wrote `answer.json` in the repo root as `{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "is_redeemable"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && grep -n "redemption\|def " discounts.py | head -60; grep -n "coupon" engine.py | head -40
cd billing && sed -n 50,72p discounts.py; grep -n "coupon" subscriptions.py

sed -i 's/coupon\["times_redeemed"\] > coupon\["max_redemptions"\]/coupon["times_redeemed"] >= coupon["max_redemptions"]/' discounts.py && cd .. && echo '{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "is_redeemable"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3

sed -i '' 's/coupon\["times_redeemed"\] > coupon\["max_redemptions"\]/coupon["times_redeemed"] >= coupon["max_redemptions"]/' discounts.py && cd .. && echo '{"file": "discounts.py", "function": "is_redeemable"}' > answer.json && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3
